method: Goals per 60 of man-advantage time = attempts/60 x unblocked share x xG per unblocked attempt x goals per xG. Each factor is shrunk toward the league by its own measured reliability, so a hot two weeks or a lucky goalie moves the grade only as far as the data says it should. 100 = league average; PK+ above 100 = fewer goals allowed. Time comes from shift data (both goalies in net); a 5-second power play counts for 5 seconds.
